context: A business is considering how political and legal conditions could affect its operations.
stem: Select the statement that best describes a possible benefit of regulation for a business.

options.label: A
options.text: It guarantees that the business will make a profit.

options.label: B
options.text: It can create common standards that increase customer trust.

options.label: C
options.text: It removes all competition from the market.

options.label: D
options.text: It ensures that a business has market power.

option_rationale: A is incorrect because regulation cannot guarantee profitability.
B is correct because standards can protect customers and improve trust in businesses that meet them.
C is incorrect because regulation does not necessarily remove competition.
D is incorrect because market power depends on competitive conditions such as substitutes, switching costs and barriers to entry.
